seo.title: Sustainability and Safety
seo.description: How Niraum Metals plans to work at Katujpani: forest land, topsoil kept for rehabilitation, progressive restoration, local jobs and safe sampling.

hero.title: Responsible mining at Katujpani.
hero.intro: Our commitments for the forest land around the deposit, the people who work on it and the communities nearby.

commitments.title: Four commitments for the land and its people.
commitments.confirm: These commitments will be confirmed against the project’s environmental study (EIA/IEE).

forest.title: Forest land
forest.body: The lease area is forest land. We work only inside the approved area and protect the forest around it.

topsoil.title: Topsoil kept
topsoil.body: Topsoil is stripped and stored in a yard set aside for it, ready to go back during rehabilitation.

rehab.title: Progressive rehabilitation
rehab.body: Worked-out ground is restored step by step while mining continues, not left until closure.

community.title: Local employment
community.body: We hire from nearby communities wherever the work allows.

land.title: Plan the restoration before the first cut.
land.body: Keeping topsoil and restoring worked ground as we go means the slope can return to forest. The restoration plan follows the mine scheme and the environmental study.

safety.title: Protective equipment and safe sampling.
safety.body: Field crews cut channel samples with gloves and protective equipment, and anyone can stop work that is not safe.

cta.title: Questions about how we work?
cta.body: Ask us about the project, our commitments or a bulk supply quote.
